visualObservations: Original identity is clear: light warm tan face, ginger fringe and moustache, cyan cap, ivory coat, green apron, teal tie, dark tiny feet.
Original reads as an angular toy: large rectangular cap crown and flat brim, squared face, low-resolution chunky hair clumps, planar collars and apron pieces, faceted cylindrical limbs.

Fixed target keeps that palette and character but offers rounded broad cap with shaped brim, fuller cheeks/jaw and ears, more coherent swept fringe and full moustache, curved collars/cuffs, dimensional tie, apron waist/pocket and readable shoes.
Target fabric stitching, folds and bright edge light are style cues; its framing, enlarged apparent scale and fringe halo are not capture authority.

The source all-facing action sheets show small stable feet, two-hand work gestures with native knife, and facing-independent packed salmon in hold/load. Back-facing food is largely body-occluded, as in source.
